utfall: andel menn i yrkesaktiv alder som arbeidet 1-39 uker i 1990, New Brunswick (sjenerøse dagpenger)

sitat: For example, in 1990, about 12.6% of working-age men in Maine’s northernmost counties worked between 1 and 39 weeks; just across the border in New Brunswick, the figure was 25.6%.
